name: DeadTools AI Backup Manager
author: DeadTools

sections.description:
Lite creates compact developer backups: themes, plugins, mu-plugins and core configuration files. It excludes wp-content/uploads, images, media files, archives and database dumps. Database dumps are available only in DeadTools AI Backup Manager PRO.

DeadTools AI Backup Manager is a free plugin for WordPress backups.

Lite features:

  • Create manual backups.
  • Download backup ZIP archives.
  • Restore a site from a backup.
  • View and download error logs.
  • Delete backup archives from the interface.
  • Create a manual full backup before updating WordPress.

This plugin does not contain locked Pro functionality and does not require a license key.

DeadTools AI Backup Manager PRO is a separate plugin distributed from the DeadTools website. It is not included in this WordPress.org plugin package.

External services

This plugin does not send data to external services.

The admin screen contains a link to the DeadTools website where users may learn about a separate Pro plugin. Opening that link is a normal browser navigation initiated by the user.

DeadTools website:
https://deadtools.ru/tools/deadtools-ai-backup-manager.php

Support email:
support@deadtools.ru

Terms of service:
https://deadtools.ru/terms.php

Privacy policy:
https://deadtools.ru/privacy.php

License

This plugin is licensed under GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from WordPress.org.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open the DeadTools AI Backup Manager menu in wp-admin.
sections.faq:
Does Lite require a license key?

No. Lite works without registration or license activation.

Are Pro features included but locked?

No. Pro features are not included in this package. They are provided by a separate plugin distributed outside WordPress.org.

  • Added portable restore path mapping for custom WordPress directory configurations.

  • Synchronized the plugin privacy policy URL with the public DeadTools website URL.
  • Renamed plugin global class and JavaScript localization object to use the unique dtaibm prefix for WordPress.org review.

2.2.3

  • Fixed WordPress.org review findings related to plugin naming prefixes and public privacy policy URL.

2.2.2

  • Fixed Plugin Check findings for WordPress.org review: updated Tested up to and clarified nonce handling for admin form processing.

2.2.1

  • Added progress bar and UI locking for long backup/restore operations.
  • Technical update: keeps the same plugin identity for smooth replacement by the PRO ZIP package.

2.0.0

  • First split Lite release for WordPress.org.
